coverage.jvm: Conservative full official upstream JVM distribution inventory; the Homebrew recipe substitutes only the pinned libsignal-client build. JVM source JARs and POMs match every remaining upstream artifact. This is source coverage, not a claim all distribution classes survive native-image reachability.
coverage.cargo: All external packages in the libsignal workspace Cargo.lock, with registry checksums and pinned git archives, plus the exact BoringSSL submodule. This intentionally over-includes development/other-target dependencies.
coverage.native_image: Pinned GraalVM and Labs OpenJDK source plus exact historical Homebrew build recipe.
coverage.frozen_python: Native binary inventory from the frozen worker must match every locked Homebrew package/version. Exact source archives and installed build recipes are retained.
